caption:
Mysore Malliga rice online, delivered all over India: ven pongal with A2 bilona ghee for a Karthika Monday dinner 🪔🍚 వెన్ పొంగల్
💬 After the deepam: ven pongal or curd rice? 👇

Save this no-onion, no-garlic recipe (serves 3) 👇
🛒 You need: 1 cup Mysore Malliga rice · ½ cup yellow moong dal · 4 cups water · salt · 3 tbsp A2 bilona ghee · 1 tsp black peppercorns · 1 tsp cumin · 1 tsp grated ginger · curry leaves · 10 cashews
1️⃣ Rinse the rice and dal until the water runs clear.
2️⃣ Pressure-cook with 4 cups water and salt for 3–4 whistles; mash lightly.
3️⃣ Melt the ghee, crackle pepper and cumin, add ginger, curry leaves and cashews.
4️⃣ Pour the tadka over the pongal, mix, and serve hot.

Malliga means jasmine: Mysore Malliga is a fragrant rice with a fluffy texture and soft, separate grains (also great for curd rice). The pack is 100% Mysore Malliga rice, no additives or preservatives. Small vendor spotlight: Veda Bharath, on Pure Organic Zone.
